Affected execution: R1 live-probe-c52977ff-6f83-46ab-8684-77daa98b2328/c6861861-11d1-4784-88b9-33ddc6c31450.

R3 (greet) is not implemented. /home/user/probes/dreambox-7/autodev-probe/app.mjs line 3 is still `greet=name=>""`. The task stays UNVERIFIED in the backlog (execution null) and is scheduled for milestone M2.

R4 (clamp) is not implemented. /home/user/probes/dreambox-7/autodev-probe/app.mjs line 4 is still `clamp=(n,min,max)=>0`. The task stays UNVERIFIED in the backlog (execution null) and is scheduled for milestone M2.

The HTTP handler in the shared adapter (/home/user/Claude-enhancement-system/examples/api-check.mjs) only calls add() and greet(). As a result, the R2-api and R4-api HTTP requests do not exercise divide or clamp, and the R1-api HTTP assertion only checks that `sum` is a number. This is a coverage limit of the fixed acceptance adapter, which must not be weakened or edited. The final audit should report P3 coverage per requirement honestly and not overstate it.

The independent final Sonnet review, the Opus final audit, the parent-only termination proof, state end and verify.mjs have not happened yet. The mission is not complete. P2 and P4 can only be fully confirmed at the final stage.

P5 (acceptance tests not weakened) was checked only by reading the file. The R1-R4 assertions in api-check.mjs match the mission text. This read-only audit could not confirm the common repo's git cleanliness or history. The final verify should confirm that the common-repo adapter is unmodified.
